publisher: Connecticut Secretary of the State, Business Services Division
ownership: Official public Business Registry records published by the Connecticut Secretary of the State
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS Socrata API.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata and selected-field API queries
redistribution of approved normalized public fields with source attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing source Active status as independent proof of current operations, good standing, solvency, public access, licensure, or an open storefront
representing a reported business address or source geocode as a verified physical operating site
representing this state registry as every business operating in Connecticut or the United States
exporting business or survey email addresses, ownership-category survey answers, agents, principals, organizers, or other person-linked subsidiary records
treating the placeholder ALEI 0000000 as a unique identifier
merging organizations across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: Connecticut Secretary of the State, Business Services Division, Connecticut Business Registry - Business Master.
retention: Indefinite for immutable selected-field source and approved normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Approved normalized fields may be redistributed with Connecticut Secretary-of-the-State attribution, source refresh timestamp, source checksum, provenance, field exclusions, and status/address limitations retained; the selected-field raw snapshot remains internal.
personal_data_handling: This connector deliberately excludes email, ownership-survey, agent, principal, organizer, and other person-linked fields and datasets. Organization names can incidentally contain a person's name because that is the registered organization name.
